subject: Request: education promo allocation for multi-campus research consortium
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Santiago <elena.santiago@nsu.edu>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Campus IT <it-support@nsu.edu>, Dr. Marcus Reed <m.reed@midstate.edu>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: education promo allocation for multi-campus research consortium

Hi Stephanie,

I lead the NLP consortium across the Northern State University system (NSU) and we're preparing a multi-campus pilot focused on low-resource language modeling for regional dialects. We're largely grant-funded and have a limited cloud/inference budget for the pilot. A few details:
- 5 labs across 3 campuses
- estimated 150k tokens/month during active experiments (token bursts during eval cycles)
- strict data residency requirements for some datasets

We're exploring vendor education promotions and trial top-ups to run initial runs and validate evaluation pipelines before we ask our funder for more funds. Would Redwood consider an education promo allocation or trial extension to cover the first 3 months? We can provide the consortium MOU and a letter from the grant PI.

I've attached the consortium scope document and a filled eligibility form. If helpful, happy to schedule a 30-min call this week.

Thanks,
Elena
Dr. Elena Santiago
Director, Center for Computational Linguistics
Northern State University
(elena.santiago@nsu.edu)

Attachments: consortium_scope-20270405.docx (docx), NSU_Nonprofit_EligibilityForm.pdf (pdf)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Elena Santiago <elena.santiago@nsu.edu>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: education promo allocation for multi-campus research consortium

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for the detailed attachments. This sounds like a great fit for our education program.

Quick ask so I can route internally:
1) Are all campuses under a single legal entity (Northern State University) or separate colleges?
2) Do you need VPC/private deployment for the pilot or will hosted with region locks suffice initially?
3) Any procurement timeline / PO needed in the next 30 days?

Internally I will route to our grants approvals and check on a promotional allocation we can extend for 3 months. Ben and Karthik — can you weigh in on the usual range for multi-campus pilots and if we can approve an initial 200k token allocation plus a 30-day trial extension while we confirm the residency requirements?

If yes, Elena — can you confirm a point of contact for SSO/IT to validate residency constraints?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: education promo allocation for multi-campus research consortium

Looping in pricing context — we have precedent for multi-lab education promos, typically a 90-day allocation in the 100k-250k token range plus trial extensions for evaluation. For a 5-lab consortium, recommend:
- Promo allocation: 200,000 tokens (hosted)
- Trial extension: +30 days on top of standard 14-day trial if requested
- Conditional on signing a simple MOU and confirming data residency option (region lock or Private deployment scope)

Karthik — do we need any lead approval for >150k? If so I'll ask Finance to sign off. Diego has signed similar MOUs for campus programs earlier this year.

Ben
Head of Academic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Elena Santiago <elena.santiago@nsu.edu>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: education promo allocation for multi-campus research consortium

Hi Elena — good news. We can approve a 200,000-token education promo allocation and extend your trial by 30 days to support the first evaluation cycle. Next steps:
1) Please confirm that Northern State University is a single legal entity for contracting purposes (reply is fine).
2) Sign the attached short MOU (attached as a DocuSign link below) — it includes the residency options and limited-use credits terms.
3) Provide an IT contact for SSO / region lock testing (cc'd it-support isn't necessary but please include someone).

DocuSign link (MOU): https://www.docusign.com/--/NSU-mou-20270407
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DL-2027-1832

If you confirm these items, I'll provision the allocation and share the promo code and admin instructions. Happy to set a 20-min tech check with our Solutions Engineer during provisioning.

Thanks and congrats to the consortium — excited to see what you build.

— Stephanie
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Tel: +1 415-555-0198
